title: Provider and tool contract qualification
description: Use for the recurring provider and tool contract qualification workflow in an explicitly authorized project. Do not use for one-off explanation or unapproved execution.
purpose: Qualify a provider route for an agent workflow using reproducible behavior and failure-mode checks rather than model-name assumptions.
project_context: Synthetic reference capability; no customer, production environment or previous approval is implied.
source_of_truth: The explicit request and authorized project artifacts; discover their actual locations before execution.
triggers: A request to formalize or repeat this operational workflow.

inputs.name: Workflow contract
inputs.validation: Identify schemas, allowed tools, privacy limits and required outcomes.

inputs.name: Candidate configuration
inputs.source: Reviewed local config or test fixture
inputs.validation: Identify protocol/version and route without copying a secret into this folder.

outputs.name: verification-report.md
outputs.acceptance: Contains scope, revision, actual evidence, unresolved risks and a bounded status.

steps.action: Freeze evaluation cases and acceptance criteria before comparing provider outputs.
steps.evidence: Versioned case list including invalid tool arguments and missing credentials.

steps.action: Test deterministic adapters and fake tools before any authorized network call.
steps.evidence: Fixture tests labeled synthetic, separate from live integration.

steps.action: Exercise timeout, rate limit, authentication failure, malformed response and uncertain tool completion.
steps.evidence: Per-case trace with no uncontrolled retry of side effects.

steps.action: Evaluate privacy and data-residency constraints for fallback, memory and telemetry.
steps.evidence: Route allowlist or explicit disabled fallback.

steps.action: Report measured quality, latency and cost only for executed cases and state missing metrics.
steps.evidence: Acceptance report with provenance, uncertainty and critical failures.

checks.criterion: Malformed tool arguments are rejected before external side effects.
checks.method: Run a negative adapter fixture and inspect event log.
checks.evidence: Rejected call with zero side effects.

checks.criterion: An uncertain successful tool write is not blindly retried.
checks.method: Simulate timeout after commit and inspect idempotency behavior.
checks.evidence: Stable operation id and reconciliation result.

checks.criterion: Missing latency/cost measurements are not reported as zero.

constraints: Do not copy credentials, private client facts or unrelated memory into this capability.
Do not infer authorization from a task description, a role prompt or a passing test.
Do not invent executed checks, performance metrics or human approvals.
approvals: Material external side effects, destructive changes, publication and privilege expansion need explicit contextual approval.

decisions.when: Fallback would send data to an unapproved provider
decisions.then: Refuse fallback and report the blocked route.
decisions.otherwise: Use only a pre-authorized route after contract verification.

assumptions: This is a synthetic reusable example, not a completed production run.
pending: Bind the workflow to an authorized project and verify its external tool contracts before execution.

files.purpose: Record an evidence-backed report without fabricated defaults.
files.origin: Original synthetic template authored for this boilerplate.
files.content:
# Verification report template

This is a template, not an execution record.

## Scope and revision
Record actual scope and revision.

## Executed checks
For each check: source, command/method, observed result and evidence location.

## Not tested or blocked
Record missing dependencies and why no result is claimed.

## Risk and decision
Distinguish technical recommendation from human authorization.
